# test_count_vowels.py

import pytest

from your_module import count_vowels


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param("hello", 2, id="simple-lowercase"),
        pytest.param("HELLO", 2, id="uppercase"),
        pytest.param("HeLLo WoRLd", 3, id="mixed-case"),
        pytest.param("aeiou", 5, id="all-vowels"),
        pytest.param("AEIOUaeiou", 10, id="all-vowels-mixed-case"),
        pytest.param(
            "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog",
            11,
            id="full-sentence",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_count_vowels_happy_path(text, expected):
    assert count_vowels(text) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param("", 0, id="empty-string"),
        pytest.param("bcdfg", 0, id="no-vowels"),
        pytest.param("rhythm", 0, id="y-not-counted"),
        pytest.param("   \n\t", 0, id="whitespace-only"),
        pytest.param("12345!@#$%", 0, id="digits-and-punctuation"),
        pytest.param("a1-e2_i3.o4/u5", 5, id="vowels-with-punctuation"),
        pytest.param("áéíóúÁÉÍÓÚ", 0, id="accented-vowels-not-counted"),
        pytest.param("😀a😀E", 2, id="unicode-with-ascii-vowels"),
    ],
)
def test_count_vowels_edge_cases(text, expected):
    assert count_vowels(text) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_input",
    [
        pytest.param(None, id="none"),
        pytest.param(123, id="int"),
        pytest.param(3.14, id="float"),
        pytest.param(["a", "e"], id="list"),
        pytest.param({"text": "aeiou"}, id="dict"),
    ],
)
def test_count_vowels_invalid_inputs_without_lower_raise_attribute_error(bad_input):
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        count_vowels(bad_input)  # type: ignore[arg-type]


def test_count_vowels_bytes_input_raises_type_error():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        count_vowels(b"aeiou")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
